name: Sierpinski
description: Sierpinski's triangle, from the one-line rule that generates it: a cell is filled when its column AND its row leave the row unchanged.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 26%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match((@x - 1) & (@y - 1) == @y - 1) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :after { inset: 8%; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
